subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with dark hair swept into a loose messy bun with long wispy strands framing her face, fair skin with rosy blush and glossy coral-pink lips, wearing a sage-green velvet halter top with a purple floral print and a front string bow tied at the chest, layered over a white camisole, with a cream sheer open-knit lace cardigan over her shoulders.
<Subject 2> is the minimalist cafe storefront in <Picture 2>: a clean white plaster wall; a large warm-wood-framed window with white sheer curtains and a protruding wooden sill shelf; to the right of the window, black capital letters "AFOUR" mounted on the wall with a small woven basket fixed above them and a small recessed square wall niche below; at the far right a wooden door with frosted glass; and on the grey tiled pavement in front of the wall, from left to right, a terracotta pot with a leafy plant at the left edge, a woven rectangular basket planter with a bushy green plant, a tall wooden chair, a small spindle-back wooden chair, a white cylindrical pot with a grassy plant, and a small dark pot with a leafy plant tucked behind it.
summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second six-shot atmospheric golden-hour "vibe" short of <Subject 1> in front of the cafe storefront of <Subject 2>, packed with natural candid micro-gestures - tracing the wooden window sill, tucking hair behind her ear, walking with hands clasped behind her back, shading her brow against the warm sun, sitting on the small wooden chair with a puffy-cheek pout breaking into a covered-mouth laugh, an on-the-spot spin with a playful shrug, touching a leaf and catching the light in her palm - ending on a quiet blink-and-smile close-up, with handheld filmic texture, backlit hair rim, and no dialogue.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, loose messy bun with face-framing wispy strands, blush and glossy coral-pink lip makeup, sage-green velvet floral halter top with chest bow, white camisole, and cream sheer lace cardigan are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the white plaster wall, wood-framed window with sheer curtains and sill shelf, the "AFOUR" lettering, wall basket, recessed niche, frosted-glass door, and the exact layout of the two wooden chairs and four planters keep their positions unchanged.
detailed_description:
The target video uses a handheld filmic vlog style with soft halation, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, and a warm golden-hour palette: low angled sunlight rakes across the white plaster wall, rim-lighting loose hair strands with a golden edge while the doorway and wall edges fall into soft shadow. Global rules: no dialogue; prop ledger locked at opening - exactly four planters (left-edge terracotta pot, woven basket planter, white cylindrical pot, small dark pot), two wooden chairs (tall chair, small spindle-back chair), one wall-mounted woven basket, one recessed wall niche, one frosted-glass door, one wood-framed window with curtains, and no object outside this list ever appears; every prop keeps its position for the whole video, and the small spindle-back chair never shifts even when <Subject 1> sits on it and stands up; the "AFOUR" lettering keeps its original spelling and stays crisp and legible whenever in frame; the sheer curtains only sway gently behind the glass and the door stays closed; no other people appear; her hands return to a natural rest between gestures.
[Shot 1] The video opens dreamy and slightly defocused with gentle halation, then racks into sharp focus within the first second. A medium shot shows <Subject 1> in profile in front of the wood-framed window of <Subject 2>, warm raking light on the white wall behind her, one hand raised with fingertips lightly tracing the protruding wooden sill while the sheer curtain sways softly behind the glass. Noticing the camera, she turns her face toward it, her lips parting in a small surprised "oh" that melts into a soft smile as her other hand tucks a loose strand behind her ear. End state: <Subject 1> at a three-quarter angle facing the camera, hand at her ear, soft smile.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, inheriting the previous end state with the tucking hand just lowering, the shot cuts to a handheld follow shot: the camera backs up as <Subject 1> walks toward it along the white wall, passing the "AFOUR" lettering, which stays crisp and legible. She clasps her hands behind her back and tilts her head; the low sun catches her eyes, so she raises one hand to her brow to shade them, gazing off into the distance, then closes her eyes into the warm breeze with a crinkled closed-eye smile. End state: <Subject 1> stopped in front of the two wooden chairs, shading hand lowering, closed-eye smile.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, inheriting the closed-eye smile, the shot cuts to a medium shot as <Subject 1> opens her eyes, steps to the small spindle-back wooden chair and sits down on it, the chair staying exactly in its locked position. With hands resting on her knees she leans her upper body slightly forward, puffs her cheeks in a playful pout, then breaks into a covered-mouth laugh with her shoulders shaking, the laugh opening into a clean toothy sweet smile with her head tilted. End state: <Subject 1> seated on the small wooden chair, hands on her knees, toothy smile at the lens.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, inheriting the seated smile, the shot cuts to a medium-full shot as <Subject 1> stands up smoothly, the small chair remaining unmoved in its locked spot, steps into the open pavement and flows into one on-the-spot spin, the cream lace cardigan flaring and loose strands swirling, the spin's motion blur whipping through the frame as a natural transition. Stopping, she clasps her hands behind her back, leans her upper body slightly forward and gives a small playful shrug with a pouty grin that breaks into a mischievous smile, head tilted. End state: <Subject 1> standing, hands clasped behind her back, leaning slightly forward, head tilted, mischievous smile at the camera.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, inheriting the tilted-head smile, the shot cuts to a medium close shot as <Subject 1> straightens up and steps beside the woven basket planter, lightly touching a leaf with one fingertip so the leaf sways gently and settles, then raising an open palm as if to catch the warm golden light. Her gaze drifts from the lens to the side, up to the sky, and back to the lens; her lashes lower in a shy downward glance and rise again, her lips calm and slightly parted. End state: <Subject 1> standing beside the planters, hand lowered, calm slightly parted lips, eyes resting on the lens.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.500, inheriting the calm parted-lip look, the shot cuts to a quiet stable close-up with the warm white wall and wood-framed window glowing softly out of focus behind her, golden rim light on the wisps of her bun. A loose strand drifts across her cheek in the light breeze; she gives one soft blink and a faint closed-lip smile blooms with a small head tilt to the other side, holding this gentle expression steady until the final frame. End state: still close-up, faint smile, eyes resting on the lens.
overall_soundscape:
A quiet lane ambience throughout: a soft warm breeze, faint rustles of plant leaves, occasional distant bird calls, and very faint muffled cafe murmur with a tiny cup clink through the window; soft footsteps on tiled pavement in [Shot 2], a brief wooden creak of the small chair as she sits in [Shot 3], a soft fabric whoosh during the spin in [Shot 4], and a single leaf flutter when touched in [Shot 5].
non_diegetic_music:
A gentle literary indie-folk cue: fingerpicked nylon-string guitar with a soft music-box sparkle and a warm airy pad; it builds through the walk in [Shot 2], swells brightly at the spin in [Shot 4], then drops to sparse guitar harmonics and a lone music-box note under the final close-up in [Shot 6], fading out on the last frame.
